name: tavily-search
description: Search real news via Tavily, reaching major outlets (NYT, WSJ, Reuters, BBC, etc.) that Claude's built-in web tools can't fetch directly. Each teammate uses their own free Tavily account/key, not a shared one.

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API Key
